name: agentic-github-flow-guards
description: Claude Code hooks that refuse destructive git commands and ask before personal data leaves the machine.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code hooks that refuse destructive git commands and ask before personal data leaves the machine.
interface.longDescription: A git guard that blocks force-push, hard reset, history rewrites and discarded work in any spelling, and a personal-data check on outbound tool calls. The installer adds the matching deny list and the Codex rules.
